optional_archive: $ROOT/edge/release-v1/ruyitrace-public-edge-tls-lease-v1-linux-arm64.docker.tar.gz (supply exact bytes via --archive PATH, never place it in Git)
copy_rule: Copy producer bytes verbatim; collect valid raw JSON only. Never export invitation, cookie, key, raw payload, or unfiltered lease state.

root_variables.QA: actual absolute loopback QA root from --qa-root
root_variables.SOURCE: actual absolute reviewed 6002ac28cdcfe8d5c8ac0340f96d258de80038a8 checkout or approved import

raw.private-native.json: $ROOT/evidence/release-v1/private-native-report.json (exact passing producer stdout after reviewed readiness-only retest)
raw.private-first-failure.json: $ROOT/evidence/release-v1/private-qa-failed-a3df818a211dacd7/private-native-report.json (or the exact native-cli-cut/prior-private-qa.json bytes, not the diagnostic wrapper)
raw.production-verified-release.json: stdout of production /usr/local/libexec/ruyitrace-demo/demo-public.sh verified-release on oracle-reverse-dev
raw.external-desktop.json: stdout of $SOURCE/product/arm64/network/verify_external.py --public-desktop; capture from independent direct public Firefox path
raw.post-cleanup.json: new redacted observations from oracle-reverse-dev and OCI after cleanup; remaining_qa_units counts unit files, loaded_qa_units inventories matching loaded services, timers and implicit slices independently

private_readiness_recovery.timing: Recovery checked_utc <= completion_utc <= resumed post-kernel-result.started. Times are UTC RFC3339 at second resolution.
private_readiness_recovery.scope: Readiness-only private QA source override: the original assembler, both image configs and all public fixture sources stay unchanged. The recovered report is a new run with canvas_input_ready and all three page clicks, and its exact bytes are bound by the unmodified Assembly checkpoint, recovery proof, and release lock.

post_cleanup.checked_utc: UTC RFC3339 timestamp at/after native loopback and public desktop results
post_cleanup.public_leaf_sha256: SHA-256 of currently projected independently verified public leaf (DER), equal to external desktop and native CLI
post_cleanup.qa_ca_sha256: SHA-256 of the dedicated loopback CA (DER), distinct from public leaf and known public roots

iptables_sha256.before: SHA-256 of original host firewall rule policy
iptables_sha256.after: same SHA-256 after verifying the cleanup; omit transient counters in both serializations

oci_admission_sha256.before: SHA-256 of canonical initial OCI admission rules
oci_admission_sha256.after: same SHA-256 after refreshing OCI admission rules; use identical canonical sorting

source_provenance.integration_tag_note: Use these existing commit object IDs to prepare or review refs before release. The verifier checks immutable source ancestry independently of tags and checkout HEAD, then emits the post-evidence index without requiring a new tag or gitlink first.

confirmation.meaning: Automated verification index, not a human signature. Capture stdout only after exit 0, then run normal --release. Evidence is scoped to the reviewed private platform collection; an unsigned index is not a cryptographic attestation against a controller of that collection. --archive independently verifies compressed bytes and the native Docker config/layer graph.
